item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 26/Nov/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A broad band of clouds will cover Guangdong today and tomorrow. Winds will be weak over the coast of Guangdong early next week, and it will be rather warm during the day. A cold front is expected to move across southern China later on Tuesday to Wednesday morning. Under the influence of the following intense northeast monsoon, the weather will become cool appreciably and windy over the coast of southern China midweek next week.
